name: Padded Stand-Collar Bomber Jacket
description:
Padded bomber jacket with a stand collar, a double-zip front with snap placket, ribbed cuffs and hem, and a zip pocket on the sleeve. Snap-flap hand pockets, a hidden inner pocket and a quilted puffer inner layer. Loose cut. The supplier describes it as windproof and warm.

Sizes M to 3XL are assumed, not confirmed. It may run about a size small: go one up.

source.notes: Price ¥93 from 1 piece (screenshot: ≈₦20,741.61), ¥90 from 100 pieces. Supplier title: Winter New Men's Jacket Loose Stand Collar Outdoor Windproof Warm Temperature-Locking Cotton Coat (the supplier's "Trendy Brand" wording is left out). Windproof and warm are supplier claims; fibre content not stated and not listed. Store return rate 53% (very high for a garment; owner must decide). Colours Black, Grey, Khaki (supplier 黑色/灰色/卡其); the khaki photo looks olive. Sizes not shown: M-3XL and the go-one-up line are assumed. Winter-weight coat: suits harmattan and cold travel, heavy for most Nigerian weather. Store photos cropped from 800 px originals (soft; sleeve tips trimmed slightly). The grey back view is the only back photo. Group photo and detail collage not used (Chinese text). Freight and customs not known. REJECTED by owner: 53% store return rate. If revisited with a better supplier, owner preference was price ₦38,000, sizes M-3XL, 3 colours (Black, Grey, Khaki).
